topics.name: Introduction to Python Programming
topics.description: Python programming is the process of writing code using the Python language, known for its readability and versatile use in web development, data science, automation, and more.
topics.learning_objectives: Learn what Python is and why it is a popular programming language. Learn about the history of Python and its design philosophy focusing on readability. Learn about the different domains and industries where Python is used (web development, data science, automation, etc.). Learn about the different roles Python can play in software development (from simple scripting to large applications). See concrete examples of simple Python code and its outcomes. Understand the community and resources available for learning Python. What is the current state of usage of Python worldwide?
